component.name: Sundrift
component.summary: Find real travel deals from Ottawa and Toronto

description.p: Tell Sundrift what kind of trip you want — where, how much, how many people, all-inclusive, beach, pool — and it checks travel sites for real prices and shows the best matches with a link to book.
Real prices come from Transat, Sunwing, Air Transat, Flair and Carnival. Sundrift opens in your web browser and runs on your own computer.
